Commandant
Shanghai Municipal Council.
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No 22
January 22nd 1916
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
It is reported that a code telegram has been received at the Arsenal requesting the authorities there to keep a sharp look out for Chen Chi Mei 陳其美. The telegram states that the person who arrests the famous rebel will receive $100,000 reward.
The two men who were expelled from Dalny where they tried to get up anti-monarchical meetings, and who were arrested on arrival in Shanghai for being in possession of bombs and revolutionary papers were shot at the Arsenal at 2 p.m. 21st inst. The execution of these men whose names are Za is Eu 查士安 and Pih Tsa Dung 畢茨東 has not been publicly announced.
It is reported that the rebels in Shanghai are preparing a circular which they intend to send to all Consulates, requesting the various Consuls not to recognise Yuan Shih Kai as emperor.
It is reported that Admiral Liu has suggested to Admiral Li to disband the officers and men of the cruiser Yung Foong as they are reported to be all enrolled as rebels.
The refugees who were yesterday reported to be in Loh Ka Aung 陸家巷 have now divided. According to the latest report some of them are at each of the following places:- Ching Ka Jao 金家橋 Yang Ching 洋 Zau Ka Liu 趙家樓 Ching Sz Nyang Di 欽賜仰殿 and Lung Wong Miao 龍王廟. It is said that the Chinese authorities are taking steps to prevent them from crossing the Whangpoo.
Two reports resembling the sound of big guns were heard in the Settlement at 9.45 p.m. 21st inst. It is said that the strange noise was caused by the blowing up of a Japanese wrecked steamer on the river.

Your Obedient Servant,
William Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

警務處長
上海工部局。
刑事偵緝處。
I. O. REG
第 22 號
1916年1月22日
（印：上海工部局警務處）

警務處，
（偵探分部）

鈞座：

據報，兵工廠收到一封密電，要求該處當局嚴密監視陳其美。電文稱，逮捕這位著名反叛者的人將獲得十萬美元賞金。

兩名男子曾在達爾尼（Dalny）試圖組織反君主制集會而被驅逐出境，抵達上海時因持有炸彈和革命文件被捕，於本月21日下午2時在兵工廠被槍決。這兩名被执行死刑的男子姓名為查士安（Za is Eu）和畢茨東（Pih Tsa Dung），此事尚未公開宣佈。

據報，上海的反叛者正在準備一份通函，擬發送給各領事館，請求各位領事不承認袁世凱為皇帝。

據報，劉海軍上將已向李海軍上將建議，解散「永豐」號巡洋艦的官兵，因為據報他們已全部登記為反叛者。

昨日據報位於陸家巷的難民現已分散。根據最新報告，其中一些人分別位於以下各處：金家橋、洋涇、趙家樓、欽賜仰殿和龍王廟。據稱，中國當局正採取措施防止他們渡過黃浦江。

本月21日晚上9點45分，租界內聽到兩聲類似大炮的聲音。據稱，這奇怪的噪音是由於江上一艘日本失事輪船被炸毀所致。

職
威廉·阿姆斯特朗（William Armstrong）
總探長

警務處總監
